text:
Here is the test suite in Gherkin (BDD DSL) notation:

```gherkin
Feature: Self-Test
  As a user
  I want to run the self-test
  So that I can validate the flow sensor accuracy and pressure sensor accuracy

  Scenario: Pre-test mode
    Given the controller is in pre-test mode
    When the GUI is opened
    Then the pre-test mode is displayed

  Scenario: Flow sensor accuracy
    Given the blower is set to 50% speed
    And the air lines are open
    And nothing is connected to the output
    When the self-test is run
    Then the flow sensor accuracy is validated with a value of 5.0 L/min

  Scenario: Pressure sensor accuracy
    Given the pressure sensor is calibrated
    When the self-test is run
    Then the pressure sensor accuracy is validated with a value of 10.0 mbar

  Scenario Outline: Pre-test mode checks
    Given the controller is in pre-test mode
    When the self-test is run
    Then the following checks are performed:
      | Check        | Expected Value |
      | Flow sensor  | 5.0 L/min      |
      | Pressure sensor| 10.0 mbar     |
      | Temperature  | 20.0°C        |

    Examples:
      | Check        | Expected Value |
      | Flow sensor  | 5.0 L/min      |
      | Pressure sensor| 10.0 mbar     |
      | Temperature  | 20.0°C        |

  Scenario: Invalid pre-test mode
    Given the controller is not in pre-test mode
    When the self-test is run
    Then an error message is displayed

  Scenario: Invalid flow sensor accuracy
    Given the blower is set to 0% speed
    And the air lines are closed
    And something is connected to the output
    When the self-test is run
    Then the flow sensor accuracy is not validated

  Scenario: Invalid pressure sensor accuracy
    Given the pressure sensor is not calibrated
    When the self-test is run
    Then the pressure sensor accuracy is not validated
```

And here is the JSON list of test cases:
